reason: Episode collected SEO numbers from GSC, GA4, RankMySEO and Ubersuggest and appended a snapshot to docs/31. Non-obvious rules surfaced: GA4 opened on the wrong property and a 28-day table stayed empty after a range change; RankMySEO clicks are sourced from GSC so the two are not independent; Ubersuggest free-tier features are locked; tool suggestions are not decisions. No existing skill covers this class, so it is created as the umbrella for SEO metric collection and recording.

Episode pruned seven zero-impression comparison pairs and measured sibling-page similarity (76%). The skill covers reading numbers but has no rule for acting on programmatic pages with them. Add it so the next pruning uses the same reversible approach.

Episode read RankMySEO issues: the 152 "Blocked from indexing" URLs were all below-threshold /e/ pages (noindex by design), and the duplicate/empty meta issues came from the status subdomain. The agent had to correct its own review date (Home card 8 Nov vs issue page 5 Nov). The skill has no triage rule for RankMySEO, so future snapshots would misread by-design noindex as errors.

Episode GA4 read: default Traffic acquisition view showed channel groups only; agent had to switch to Session source / medium to see l.threads.com, checkout.pymnt.app and similar referrers. The agent also first wrote "60% dari 60 key event" as a computed figure and then corrected it to the table's own value. The skill lacks guidance on dimension choice and on not mislabelling referral traffic.

In the 9 Nov SEO snapshot the indexing counts matched the 4 Nov snapshot exactly because the GSC page indexing report still showed "Last update 23 Okt". The agent had to infer staleness mid-run. Also a 404 group was being considered for "Validate fix" when the sampled URLs were correct 404s.
